Minister Rajmohan stated that TVK candidate P. Sathyabama was targeted with an AI-manipulated video, and the office should monitor the political fallout.
DMK leader M.K. Stalin criticized the state government over recent violent incidents and law and order issues, and the office should watch political reactions.
TVK Dharapuram by-election candidate P. Sathyabama denied viral claims that she spent 31 crore rupees during the previous election, and the office should track updates.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to inaugurate the Porur-Poonamallee metro rail service, following a successful trial run, and the office should watch regional transit expansion.
Trial runs have been completed for the upcoming Porur-Poonamallee metro stretch ahead of its formal launch by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and the office should track connectivity benefits.
